svg.aria-label: Roadmap board: shipped, next up and later

g.text: ✓ v0.1 — the village, the stat compiler, the seeded backtest
✓ three houses — anthropic · openai · xai, 101x apart on price
✓ cost-adjusted P&L — the inference bill is subtracted
✓ persistence + CI — survives a reload, green on every push
✓ paper trading — real Robinhood Chain tokens, no keys at all
1 the first trade must not take five minutes
2 prove the OpenAI and xAI wires against a live 200
3 execute.ts verified against the real router ABI
4 latency measured per house · 5 import a build JSON
6 the tape says which house produced each verdict
7 REAL PRICES — decode the Uniswap v4 swaps
cloud save · rank villages on net · replay export · mobile layout · a fourth house, only with a reason
ordering rule: what would embarrass the project if someone read it today comes before what would impress them
